		📚 Overview
	

This is the official repository for the paper:
MVISU-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Agents for Real-World Tasks by Multi-App, Vague, Interactive, Single-App and Unethical InstructionsMVISU-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark dataset for multilingual visual understanding tasks, specifically designed for evaluating mobile agents' capabilities in real-world scenarios. This repository contains carefully curated datasets in both English and Chinese… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MVISU-Bench/MVISU-Bench.
reputation: An emerging benchmark with growing interest in the mobile-agent and multimodal communities; moderate adoption so far.
